question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e45213159a9d782f82c5ed60e9ba03e78acdab320f04755877f2b94c86051d8d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

**The Number of Vertices is reducing by one in each successive step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f89547f00227e4efff65b681898116b7d63544f6bb8d803acc1953ff25545144.png] 

Similarly, In next step number of vertices will be 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f16ec76bca4d53e78a18375783acd9282c54111d3fd734eb80e94a107254b61e.png] 

Hence, **'Option 4'** is the correct answer.
